text:
marta: Opening a follow-up thread for last night's kv-cache OOM burst (shard-7). Pattern looks similar to prior kv-frag incidents but with a notable spike in concurrent small writes interleaved with a periodic 10MB snapshot write.

ops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0488 25 paging eng-runtime oncall.

marta: Quick findings from a small heap dump: top allocs are InsertWriter(temp buffers) ~38%, slice resizes ~22%, and net/http body copies ~9%. Fragmentation ratio bumped to 0.53 right before OOM.

derek: I'll take immediate ownership of the write-path instrumentation and a micro-reproducer. Plan: add allocation counters to InsertWriter and run `kv-sim --mix=burst:heavy` to replicate. ETA: Tue EOD.

anya: I'll do ops mitigations: soft cap single-put at 6MB, enable auto-shard-fallback when frag_ratio > 0.5, and add a short-lived circuit to reject extra-large concurrent puts. Deploying a canary now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR-842.

vincent: I'll handle GC/allocator side: try more aggressive compaction policies on a dedicated canary ring and test enabling compact-on-finalizer. Need to measure CPU overhead. ETA: Wed morning with metric graphs.

marta: Action items summary (add to INC-2026-0488):
- derek: instrumentation + reproducer (Tue EOD)
- vincent: compaction canary + CPU vs frag dashboard (Wed AM)
- anya: ops soft-cap + fallback PR (in-flight)
- marta: attach heap dumps + timeline + candidate rollbacks

derek: Small note: when running reproducer, use `KV_ALLOC_TAGS=1 ./kv-sim --shard=7` to get allocation site tags. Saves a lot of guesswork.

anya: Canary deployed to 5% for 20m -> no OOMs during window. Promoting to 25%. Adding alert rule `kv.cache.frag_ratio >= 0.5 for 3m` -> page eng-runtime.

vincent: Starting compaction canary now. Will post graphs to INC-2026-0488 once we have 1h of data. Looking specifically at frag_ratio, free_segment_sizes, gc_pause_ms, cpu_user.

marta: We should also add a recurring postmortem short-check: weekly scan that searches for clusters of kv-frag alerts and correlates with deploys and model rollouts. Volunteer?

derek: I can run the weekly scan for the next 3 weeks and then rotate. Will create a template and calendar invite.

anya: Ops note: also added a short-term telemetry pipeline to collect per-shard max-request-size histograms for 48h. That should help identify offending producers.

vincent: Preliminary compaction canary results: frag_ratio dropped from 0.52 -> 0.28, but CPU increased ~12% on the canary hosts during peak. I'll push the dashboard panels and a follow-up risk analysis.

marta: Good catch. Let's avoid overlapping a heavy compaction rollout with major deploys. Coordinate schedules.

derek: Instrumentation PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/kv/PR-829 1: adds allocation counters + microbench harness. Running CI now.

anya: Ops PR merged and rolled to 100% during low-traffic window with no regressions. Channel #kv-oom-watch created for immediate alerts.

marta: Next steps: derek to finish reproducer + attach pprofs to the ticket; vincent to deliver full CPU/frag cost analysis; anya to keep ops mitigations in place for 72h. We'll pick a postmortem owner after the incident is quiet; provisional co-owners: derek+vincent. Check-in tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Incident review in 24h for INC-2026-0488.

marta: Thanks team. Keep updates in INC-2026-0488 and this thread. :thumbsup:
